text: function start(){exitCitizenInspection();clearCitizenMeshes();scenicMeshCache=null;scenicMeshKey='';seed=83127;accumulator=0;selectedCitizen=0;routeCache.clear();routeCacheRevision=-1;cacheHits=0;cacheMisses=0;city.splice(12);state={t:7,food:180,wood:90,gold:42,homes:city.length,buildCount:city.length+2,happiness:78,lastStory:0};people=names.slice(0,12).map((name,i)=>({name,job:jobs[i%jobs.length],trait:['patient','curious','bold','generous','resourceful','loyal'][i%6],x:(rand()-.5)*14,z:(rand()-.5)*11,target:[(rand()-.5)*24,(rand()-.5)*20],phase:rand()*8,friend:null,bonds:{},energy:60+rand()*40,hunger:rand()*20,activity:'Exploring the valley',workTimer:0,friendshipRecorded:false}));for(const p of people){if(!walkable(p.x,p.z)){const spot=navSnap(p.x,p.z);if(spot)[p.x,p.z]=navPoint(...spot)}choose(p)}stories=[];report('The first families arrive in a lush and untamed valley.');report('A new settlement is born beneath the old mountain ridge.');updateUI()}

function updateUI(){const day=Math.floor(state.t/24)+1; const time=state.t%24;const climate=climateAt(state.t);document.getElementById('weather').textContent=({'clear':'☀ CLEAR SKIES','cloudy':'☁ CLOUD COVER','rain':'☂ RAINFALL','snow':'❄ SNOWFALL'}[climate.weather])+' · '+climate.seasonName;document.getElementById('clock').textContent=`DAY ${day} · ${time<6?'NIGHT':time<9?'DAWN':time<12?'MORNING':time<17?'AFTERNOON':time<20?'EVENING':'NIGHT'}`;for(let [key,val] of Object.entries({population:people.length,buildings:state.buildCount,happiness:Math.round(state.happiness)+'%',year:String(Math.ceil(day/36)).padStart(2,'0'),food:Math.floor(state.food),wood:Math.floor(state.wood),gold:Math.floor(state.gold),working:people.filter(p=>p.activity.includes("Traveling")||p.activity.includes("Harvest")||p.activity.includes("Cutting")||p.activity.includes("Bartering")||p.activity.includes("Crafting")||p.activity.includes("Foraging")||p.activity.includes("Constructing")).length}))document.getElementById(key).textContent=val;document.getElementById('progress').style.width=Math.min(98,21+people.length*1.4+state.buildCount*.8)+'%';const citizen=people[Math.min(selectedCitizen,people.length-1)];document.getElementById('citizen-name').textContent=citizen.name;document.getElementById('portrait-name').textContent=citizen.name;document.getElementById('portrait-task').textContent=citizen.job+' · '+citizen.activity;document.getElementById('citizen-detail').textContent=`${citizen.trait} ${citizen.job} · ${citizen.activity}`;document.getElementById('citizen-bond').textContent=`Energy ${Math.round(citizen.energy)}% · Hunger ${Math.round(citizen.hunger)}% · ${citizen.friend?'Friend: '+citizen.friend:'Making connections'} · Bonds ${Object.values(citizen.bonds).filter(x=>x>=1).length}`;renderResourceTrends(day)}

button('pause',()=>{frozen=!frozen;document.getElementById('pause').textContent=frozen?'▶ Resume':'Ⅱ Pause'});for(let v of [1,4,16])button('speed'+v,()=>{speed=v;for(let n of [1,4,16])document.getElementById('speed'+n).classList.toggle('active',n===v)});button('focus',()=>{follow=!follow;document.getElementById('focus').classList.toggle('active',follow)});button('camera',()=>{cinematic=!cinematic;document.getElementById('camera').classList.toggle('active',cinematic)});button('restart',()=>{exitCitizenInspection();follow=false;zoom=43;city.splice(12);start()});

const inspect=document.createElement('button');inspect.id='inspectCitizen';inspect.type='button';inspect.className='btn';inspect.textContent='Inspect up close';inspect.setAttribute('aria-label','Inspect selected citizen up close');inspect.style.cssText='border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--gold);margin:0 0 14px 8px;min-height:36px';inspect.onclick=()=>inspectCitizen();document.getElementById('cycleCitizen').after(inspect);
